story.title: Delhi HC Orders Removal of Deepfake Videos Falsely Showing MP Shashi Tharoor Praising Pakistan
story.summary: The Delhi High Court announced it would issue blocking orders against AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Congress MP Shashi Tharoor praising Pakistan, after he filed a petition over the misuse of his identity. The case marks one of the most prominent Indian legal interventions involving political deepfakes during an active security-sensitive period. The ruling signals growing judicial willingness to act swiftly against AI-generated political disinformation in India.
